description: Checks that C/C++ source and header files are correctly documented with Doxygen comments (file, functions, parameters, return values), using the settings in doxy_check/Doxyfile.check. Reports each documentation problem as file:line: message, or that everything is documented.

params.name: paths
params.description: One or more C/C++ files (.c, .h, .cc, .cpp, .hpp) or folders to check, separated by spaces, each starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump/src
